title: Right to Be Forgotten Risk Calculator | Data Deletion Assessment
metaDescription: Calculate your risk level for exercising the right to be forgotten. Assess data exposure and get personalized advice for data deletion requests.
description: Evaluate your personal data exposure risk and determine the urgency of exercising your right to be forgotten. This calculator assesses factors like data sensitivity, platform reach, and potential harm to provide a comprehensive risk score.

inputs.label: Types of personal data exposed
inputs.helpText: Consider the most sensitive type of data exposed about you

inputs.label: Number of platforms/services with your data
inputs.helpText: Include social media, shopping sites, data brokers, and other online services

inputs.label: Data visibility level
inputs.helpText: How easily can others find and access your personal information

inputs.label: Years your data has been online
inputs.helpText: Consider your oldest online accounts and shared information

inputs.label: Potential reputation impact
inputs.helpText: Consider impact on relationships, career, and personal well-being

inputs.label: Have you made data deletion requests before?
inputs.helpText: Previous experience with right to be forgotten requests

outputFields.label: Overall Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your comprehensive right to be forgotten risk level (0-100)

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Categorized risk assessment with recommended actions

outputFields.description: How quickly you should act on data deletion requests

outputFields.label: Platforms to Address
outputFields.description: Estimated number of services requiring attention

formula: const dataTypeScores = { basic: 20, sensitive: 40, protected: 70, comprehensive: 85 }; const visibilityScores = { private: 10, limited: 25, searchable: 50, viral: 80 }; const reputationScores = { none: 0, low: 15, moderate: 35, high: 60 }; const dataTypeScore = dataTypeScores[dataTypes]; const platformScore = Math.min(platformReach * 1.2, 40); const visibilityScore = visibilityScores[publicVisibility]; const timeScore = Math.min(timeOnline * 1.5, 30); const reputationScore = reputationScores[reputationImpact]; const experienceBonus = activeRequests ? -5 : 0; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, dataTypeScore + platformScore + visibilityScore + timeScore + reputationScore + experienceBonus)); let riskLevel, urgency; if (riskScore >= 70) { riskLevel = 'High Risk'; urgency = 'Immediate action recommended'; } else if (riskScore >= 40) { riskLevel = 'Moderate Risk'; urgency = 'Action within 30 days'; } else { riskLevel = 'Low Risk'; urgency = 'Monitor and plan ahead'; } const estimatedPlatforms = Math.ceil(platformReach * 0.8); return { riskScore: Math.round(riskScore), riskLevel, urgency, estimatedPlatforms };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates multiple risk factors including data sensitivity, platform exposure, public visibility, time online, and potential reputation impact. The scoring system weighs sensitive data types and high visibility scenarios more heavily, as these pose greater privacy risks and potential for harm.
tips: Start with major platforms like Google, Facebook, and data brokers when making deletion requests
Use Incognito Browser to research your online presence without creating new tracking data
Document all deletion requests with screenshots and email confirmations
Under GDPR and similar laws, companies must respond to deletion requests within 30 days
Some data may be retained for legal compliance - request details about what cannot be deleted
Set up Google Alerts for your name to monitor new appearances of your personal data
Consider using privacy-focused alternatives to prevent future data accumulation

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Your data exposure appears minimal. Focus on preventing future data accumulation and maintain good privacy habits.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some concerning data exposure exists. Consider making targeted deletion requests for the most sensitive information.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy risks identified. Prioritize deletion requests for high-visibility platforms and sensitive data.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Urgent action needed. Begin comprehensive data deletion campaign immediately, starting with most damaging content.
